# v0.6.0 — 6.8× smaller download, and `size` that means what it says

Two things every user feels: the browser payload dropped from 580 KB to 85 KB
gzipped, and `{ size: 320 }` now returns a 320×320 image instead of 396×396.

Existing 0.5 code keeps working — see [MIGRATION.md](https://github.com/wirunrom/hqr-generate/blob/v0.6.0/MIGRATION.md).

| | v0.5.0 | v0.6.0 | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Browser download, generate only | ~580 KB gz | **~85 KB gz** | **6.8× smaller** |
| Decoder | always loaded | lazy, opt-in | fetched on first `decode` |
| `{ size: 320 }` on a short URL | 396 × 396 | **320 × 320** | exact |
| `{ size: 320 }` on a 1 KB payload | 298 × 298 | **320 × 320** | exact |
| npm package, unpacked | 2.94 MB | **1.95 MB** | 1.5× smaller |
| Tests | 0 | **86** | 33 Rust · 40 package · 13 browser |

## 📦 Bundle size

- **The decoder is a separate WASM module**, loaded only when `decode` is first
  called. A page that only renders QR codes never downloads it.
- **`image` is built with only png/jpeg/webp.** The default feature set compiled
  TIFF, DDS, OpenEXR, HDR, PNM, ICO, BMP and GIF decoders into the binary —
  none of which can appear in a QR scan. The decoder went from 1.4 MB to 597 KB.
- Direct `png` bumped to 0.18 to match what `image` pulls in, so the binary no
  longer carries **two copies** of the PNG codec.
- `wasm-opt` now runs with `--all-features`. Naming features by hand made it
  reject the module the moment wasm-bindgen emitted one more — silently, leaving
  the binary unoptimized.
- `npm run size` prints the numbers and **fails the build** if a binary crosses
  its budget. CI runs it on every push.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **`size` is the real output size.** 0.5 scaled from the symbol alone and added
  the quiet zone *outside* it, so a request for 320 px returned 396 px for a
  short URL — and only 298 px for a long payload. Modules still land on whole
  pixels; the leftover pixels widen the quiet zone, which scanners prefer.
  `sizeMode: 'fit'` opts into the largest whole-module image that fits instead.
- **Removed the silent 128 px floor** on `size`.
- **Node no longer loads the browser build.** The `exports` map listed `import`
  before `node`, so Node ESM could resolve to the `fetch`-based web entry and
  fail. Each `pkg/` directory now declares its own module type too, so the
  CommonJS glue is never parsed as ESM.
- **Next.js works with no configuration.** wasm-pack's Node glue locates its
  binary with `readFileSync(__dirname + "/…")`, and any bundler that inlines
  that CommonJS module rewrites `__dirname` — which broke server components,
  route handlers and serverless bundles with `ENOENT` at import time. The Node
  binaries are now inlined at build time, so there is no path left to break.
  (`serverExternalPackages` is *not* the fix: an externalized copy of the React
  hooks resolves its own `react`, and client components then fail during SSR.)
- **`ecc` and `sizeMode` are validated** instead of silently falling back to `Q`.
- **Errors are real `Error` objects with a stable `.code`** — `PAYLOAD_TOO_LONG`,
  `QR_NOT_FOUND`, `LOGO_SPACE_TOO_LARGE` … 0.5 threw a bare string, so
  `err.message` was `undefined`.
- Node and browser entries have **separate type declarations**; Node signatures
  are synchronous instead of `Promise<T> | T`.

## ✨ New

- **Centre logo.** `logoSpace` blanks a centred square; `generateSvg` also takes
  a `logo` href and draws it. Rejected with `LOGO_SPACE_TOO_LARGE` if it would
  spend more of the error-correction budget than the level can spare, or if the
  square would reach the finder patterns.
- **Camera scanning** — `@wirunrom/hqr-generate/scanner` (`createScanner`,
  `listCameras`) and the `useQrScanner` React hook. Frames via
  `requestVideoFrameCallback`, downscaled to 640 px, throttled, de-duplicated.
  Plain JS: it adds nothing to the WASM binaries.
- **Payload builders** — `@wirunrom/hqr-generate/payload`: `wifi`, `mecard`,
  `vcard`, `mailto`, `sms`, `tel`, `geo`, `otpauth`, and **`promptpay`** (Thai
  EMVCo merchant-presented QR with a CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE checksum). Each escapes
  its own separators — the failure mode otherwise is a code that scans fine and
  then does nothing.
- `generateMany(texts, opts)` — encode a batch in one crossing of the JS/WASM
  boundary; errors carry the failing `index`.
- `decodeAll(input)` — every code in the image with its pixel corners, version
  and ECC level.
- `generateModules` / `useGenerateModules` — the raw module grid, for rendering
  to canvas, inline `<svg>`, PDF or native.
- `sizeMode: 'exact' | 'fit'`, `ready({ decoder })`, camelCase names, and a
  `/node` subpath. The 0.5 snake_case names still resolve.

## 🧪 Testing & CI

There were no tests before this release.

- **33 Rust tests** — sizing maths, 1-bit scanline clearing against a naive
  reference, PNG/SVG structure, and generate→decode round trips across every ECC
  level, size, margin, logo size, and a Thai/Japanese/emoji payload set.
- **40 package tests** — the shipped entry points, `exports` resolution, the
  ESM/CJS boundary, error codes, and every payload builder (including the
  PromptPay TLV structure and its checksum against the standard CRC vector).
- **13 browser tests** — canvas round trip, lazy decoder loading, logo markup
  through `DOMParser`, and the scanner driven by a real `MediaStream` from
  `canvas.captureStream()`, so the camera path is exercised without a camera.
- `tests/my-app` is a Next.js fixture that installs the packed tarball and
  imports by package name, covering client hooks, a Server Component, a Route
  Handler and the scanner. It is what caught the bundler bug above.
- GitHub Actions: fmt, clippy on native *and* wasm targets, the Cargo feature
  matrix, all four WASM builds, package tests, `npm pack` verification, and the
  size budget.
- Publishing is tag-triggered, with **npm provenance**.
